source.title: AR5 WG1, Chapter 8, Appendix 8.A, Table 8.A.1 — GWP-100 column. Climate-carbon feedbacks are included for CO2 only; the analogous values including feedbacks for non-CO2 emissions are in Supplementary Material Table 8.SM.16 and are deliberately not used here.
source.license: Factual constants reproduced with attribution; IPCC permits reproduction of AR figures/tables with citation.

verification.method: Text extracted from the IPCC AR5 WG1 Chapter 8 PDF with pdftotext -layout, then every value compared against the GWP 100-year column of Table 8.A.1. All 14 values matched. The set-level climate-carbon feedback flag was checked against the table caption, which states that feedbacks are included for CO2 while no climate feedbacks are included for the other components.
verification.notes: AR5 remains the mandated set under several national reporting regimes, which is why it ships alongside AR6.

values.note: The table's 'Fossil methane' row. Higher than the general methane value because oxidation of fossil-origin methane adds fossil CO2.

The table's plain 'Methane' row. AR5 names only the fossil variant explicitly, so this row is the non-fossil value; AR6 labels the equivalent row 'CH4-non fossil'. This library's MethaneBiogenic member maps to both.
